title: On the Frontier
lines: The fire burns the wild grass in the wilderness.
At the edge of the burn, the horse neighs.
A soldier stands watch throughout the long night.
The frontier moon is cold, the wind is sharp.
For ten years the beacon fires have burned.
The armor is old, the sword is notched.
But still the soldier shapes his beard,
And stands his post on the northern wall.
Far away, his wife holds their child,
And teaches him to recognize his father in the stars.
When will peace return to these borderlands?
When will the hooves of horses be heard in the village again?
